# `m.reference.exchanges`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The exchanges, trade reporting facilities, and SIPs Massive knows, with their codes.

```python
m.reference.exchanges(*, asset_class=None, locale=None)
```

[All datasets](README.md)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Verbs | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| `poll()` | `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`: holds exactly the latest cycle's rows, keyed by `AssetClass` and `Id` |

## Arguments

What each argument does for this dataset, and the rule it follows for every dataset that takes it.

| Argument | For this dataset | For every dataset |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `asset_class` | The class whose exchanges to list (forex is sent as `fx`); None for every class. The endpoint has no indices exchanges. |  |
| `locale` | The locale whose exchanges to list; None for both. |  |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Acronym` | String | A commonly used abbreviation for this exchange. | REST |
| `AssetClass` | String | An identifier for a group of similar financial instruments. | REST |
| `Id` | long | A unique identifier used by Massive for this exchange. | REST |
| `Locale` | String | An identifier for a geographical location. | REST |
| `Mic` | String | The Market Identifier Code of this exchange (see ISO 10383). | REST |
| `Name` | String | Name of this exchange. | REST |
| `OperatingMic` | String | The MIC of the entity that operates this exchange. | REST |
| `ParticipantId` | String | The ID used by SIP's to represent this exchange. | REST |
| `Type` | String | Represents the type of exchange. | REST |
| `Url` | String | A link to this exchange's website, if one exists. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
